## Cobalt2

A dark-only theme inspired by the iconic [Cobalt2](https://github.com/wesbos/cobalt2) color scheme for VS Code by Wes Bos. Deep cobalt blue backgrounds with a striking yellow (`#ffc600`) accent color create an immediately recognizable, high-contrast interface.

### Highlights

- **Signature yellow accent (#ffc600)** — the unmistakable Cobalt2 touch
- **Rich cobalt blue backgrounds** — editor-authentic depth from `#0d1f2d` to `#193549`
- **High-contrast text** — pure white on dark cobalt for maximum readability
- **System fonts** — no custom font download required

### Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/cobalt2.css">
```
